'''Lightning Storm''' was a [[Force power/Legends|spell]] that was employed by some of the [[Witches of Dathomir]] and many of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. It filled the air with crackling electricity, though it was less powerful than the more focused [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] attack.

It was used against [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]] when they were following the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]]. While it did very little damage to Ben and Luke, it completely shorted out the majority of their electronics, rendering them useless. It even affected their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], though not nearly to the degree of their other electronics. It also drove off the [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] that they were battling.
